name: Removal Type And Reason 1
definition: Identifies the removal type, the reason, the exclusion period, the extension date and the termination date.

RemovalType.name: Removal Type
RemovalType.definition: Specifies the removal processing change requested.

Reason.name: Reason
Reason.definition: Identifies the reason for the removal, the extension of the removal or the termination of the removal.

ExclusionPeriod.name: Exclusion Period
ExclusionPeriod.definition: Identifies the period, the start date or the end date of the exclusion period.

ExclusionPeriodPresence.definition: Exclusion Period must be present if Removal Type is  REMO or EXTN. If the Removal Type is TERM then Exclusion Period is optional.
